articleTitle: Reshaped and Reduced Dimensionality Reduction Data Technique on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Online shops implement market basket analysis, where its association rule analysis helps people with their online shopping. Association rule's performance depends on the quality of the dataset. The association rule analysis depends on two values, namely the support value and the confidence value. There are two novelty techniques for preparing the dataset, reshape dataset technique and reduce dataset technique. The reshape dataset technique will decrease the dataset dimension on the number of rows; meanwhile, the reduced dataset technique will decrease the dataset by implementing the IST- EFP algorithm. This research compares 30%, 40%, 50%, 55% reshaped datasets against the reduced dataset. Both datasets can prune the original dataset dimension using the same confidence values on the strict rules. This research will analyze both techniques' performance by comparing the support value and confidence value against the original dataset. Both methods can reduce the dimensions of the dataset without changing the confidence value with a difference of less than 0.1% in the support value obtained; the reduced dataset has a better result.

articleTitle: Improved pattern recognition of various traditional clothes with Convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This Study would identify regional fabric patterns throughout Indonesia. Traditional clothes patterns come from the handicrafts of remote communities in the regions of Indonesia. A Convolutional neural network is used for Resnet50 V2, VGG16, VGG19, MobileNetV2, and Inception V3 models to support this research. This research was conducted on five types of experiments with supporting parameters: the number of training images and test images, rotation and scale of each image, image class, and CNN parameters. After we conducted experiments on a collection of images found in various scales and degrees, the average classification accuracy using VGG16 was 79.2% in condition 2, but the classification accuracy was between 84.2%-92.5%. Meanwhile, if using VGG19 the classification accuracy is 79.9%, with condition 1 for the highest accuracy between 92%-96%. If we used mobilenetV2, the average classification accuracy is 83.4% for 87%-96%. If we used inceptionV3, the average classification accuracy is 83.7% for the accuracy between 72%-98%, and the last if we used Resnet50 V2, the average classification accuracy is 79.2% for the accuracy between 71%-94%. Traditional clothes pattern recognition research using Deep CNN has succeeded in recognizing some traditional clothes patterns up to more than 97%. We continue the study to recognize other traditional clothes patterns more optimally.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Improvement of Power Factor of an Industrial Load
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The ability of power utilities to provide a stable power flow within the specified voltage and frequency range is a critical aspect of power system operation. In an electrical power system with a high reactive load, a power factor closer to one is a strong predictor of overall power quality. A poor power factor results in considerable power losses higher utility rates and requires the electric power utility to meet high maximum demand. So, improving the power factor is one of the most effective ways to maintain electrical power quality while also delivering several additional benefits. This article describes research conducted at an industrial site to improve power factor by integrating a capacitor bank and a comprehensive implementation of the technical and economic benefits of power factor improvement. A simulation interface is used to model and analyze the electrical network of the site with the motor loads. The capacitor bank’s size, type, and connected duration to the system are determined by analyzing the site’s power factor, active power, and reactive power values. The findings demonstrate that the suggested 130 kVAr capacitor bank can successfully increase the power factor by 4% while reducing power factor overcorrection. Furthermore, the results indicate a payback period of 16 months can be expected with monthly savings of 52470 LKR.

articleTitle: Image Processing based UR5E Manipulator Robot Control in Pick and Place Application for Random Position and Orientation of Object
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Many industries are required to increase output and productivity. Manipulator Robot is chosen as a solution, especially for pick and place applications. An intelligent system is needed to reduce uncertainty and decision-making for some varying object or workpieces. In this paper, the UR5e manipulator robot can automatically detect the object using computer vision through the camera as a sensor and OpenCV computer program. Geometrical transformations and statistical approaches transform picture data into position and orientation data for robot control. The system detects the center point coordinates and the orientation angle of the detected object. The coordinates obtained by the camera perception are transformed into robot perception. At the same time, the value of the orientation degree is converted into a quaternion form which becomes the rotational movement parameter for the end effector of the robot. Position and orientation data are sent to the robot controller from the ROS framework computer program via ethernet. The robotic arm can move towards the object, and the end effector can rotate accordingly. The experimental results prove successful recognition of object position and orientation. The system has an accuracy in detecting object positions at x-axis direction = 99.0%, at y-axis direction = 98.05%, and the system orientation accuracy is 99.11%.

articleTitle: Coplanar Waveguide Antenna Using Resistive Load for Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The antenna with wide-band operational frequency is expected to be one of the innovations of communication devices. Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) antenna is one of the antennas that have an ultra-wideband frequency. This CPW antenna has a ground plane which is located adjacent to the feed line. In this study, the CPW antenna was designed and simulated using the CST Studio Suite 2021 software to produce UWB operational frequencies. The antenna design uses FR-4 Epoxy substrate with ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> = 4.3. The antenna design is made into two forms. First, the CPW antenna is designed without resistive load. Second, the CPW antenna is coupled with a resistive load of varying values. The purpose of adding this resistive load is to widen the operational frequency of the antenna. Based on the results obtained, there is an increase in the operating frequency of the antenna when a resistive load is used. When the antenna is no resistive load, the operating frequency has a range of 2-6GHz. When the resistive load is added, the operating frequency of the antenna becomes 2-7GHz. The use of this resistive load has the disadvantage that it reduces the gain, radiation efficiency, and affects the radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Content-based Traditional Clothes Pattern Retrieval Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Indonesia is a country with an inclusive culture spread all over the country. Usually, cultural objects can have different meanings based on the details. Traditional cloth is an example of Indonesia's culture. Each province in Indonesia has various colors, patterns, textures, characteristics of traditional fabrics. However, each cloth's patterns and textures have different meanings or meanings. The various features and characteristics of traditional clothing can be extracted using the Convolutional Neural Network. This experiment uses 74 types of traditional patterns collected from the internet. Pre-processing creates 4144 new images with seven different rotation variations, four different overlap settings, and also two crop sides for the image database. CNN type for VGG19 is used as feature extraction of fabric pattern and Euclidean Distance for feature vector distance calculation. Based on the experimental results, the average output using this method is 86%. Besides that, about 69% of the results of the query process for pattern and texture images have an accuracy greater than 80%. Even some patterns can produce accuracy up to 100%. This study makes an excellent image retrieval accuracy but also needs a lot of improvement.

articleTitle: Novel Design: Development of Religious Automatic Dispenser for Hand Sanitizer or Hand Washing Soap
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: We make dispensers for hand sanitizer or automatic liquid soap that are different from those that have been made and marketed at this time. This hand sanitizer or soap dispenser accommodates spiritual elements: guidance to pray according to religious teachings verbally and recognizes the regulation for washing hands from the World Health Organization (WHO). This paper presents the technical details of making the device practically, starting from system block, components, circuits, coding algorithm until the results of performance reviews and device capabilities. For the device's performance, we also include a video link to see firsthand the shape, appearance, and implementation of the dispenser that we also made. This device is part of the system we are developing in the next project. According to WHO recommendations, this Hand Sanitizer is also equipped with a timer for washing hands.

articleTitle: Modeling of Temperature Effect on SoC of Lithium Ion Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: A battery pack consists of batteries installed in parallel and/or series. Many factors affect the performance of a battery pack, either external or internal factors such as temperature, discharge/charge current, individual cell voltage and state of charge (SoC), also the state of health (SoH). In this paper, we try to show the effect of temperature on series and parallel cell configuration inside a battery pack. The cell characteristics are based on the Panasonic NCR18650GA. Results have shown that the temperature difference affects the individual SoC of the series-connected cells. In the model, it could reach SoC difference of up to 6.9%. However, the parallel-connected cells have no SoC difference.

articleTitle: Interaction Design of Mathematics Learning Applications for Elementary School Students
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Mathematics learning applications today are certainly very widely found, and we can easily download them from the app store or play store. Starting from the elementary, middle, and high school levels. Some of the current mathematics learning applications that we encounter only focus on their content, so the application's appearance is ignored. There are too many choices for the interface in the mathematics learning application before starting mathematics learning. This makes it difficult for users, mainly grade 6 elementary school students, when interact with the application. This research aims to develop an Android-based mathematics learning application for 6th-grade elementary school children with a User-Centered Design (UCD) approach. The ability to help 6th graders of the elementary school in learning mathematics independently will improve children's motor and cognitive skills.

articleTitle: Macrobending Loss Analysis of Singlemode-Multimode-Singlemode (SMS) Optical Fiber Structures on Variation of Macro Bend and Multimode
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This research aims to (1) analyze the effect of Singlemode Multimode Singlemode (SMS) optical fiber on the variation of diameter, the number of coils, wavelength, and length of multimode at wavelengths of 1310 nm and 1550 nm, and (2) compare the losses of SMS optical fiber structure with and without macrobending. The optical fibers use singlemode G.652D type and multimode OM1 type. The macrobending variation model uses helical and S-shaped with a variation of 1-5 coils. In the helical, the radius of curvature constant (R=10 mm), the diameter of coils obtains from the variation of the helical radius, r=5 mm-9 mm. Whereas, for the S-shaped model variation of radius are, r=3 mm-12.5 mm. The total length of the SMS structure is 240 cm, with variations in the length of the multimode fiber 80 cm, 90 cm, and 100 cm relative to the length of singlemode fiber. The results showed that the smaller indentation diameter (1 cm and 0.6 cm) and the larger number of turns (5 turns) gave greater losses. Furthermore, multimode fiber with a length of 100 cm tends to have high light intensity. It was also found that the SMS structure with macrobending provides greater losses that the straight one. At the indentation diameter of 1 cm and 1.5 cm, the S-shaped model gives higher losses than the helical model at wavelengths of 1310 nm and 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Orientation Independent, Polarization Insensitive High-Density Flexible Chipless RFID Tag for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: A regular shaped octagonal flexible chipless Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag is proposed for Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The expressed flexibility leverages a chipless passive RFID technology to design a fully printable frequency-based tag. The regular octagonal shape of the proposed tag verifies its orientation independence and polarization insensitivity. The Radar Cross Section (RCS) response in the spectral domain examines the proposed tag’s performance. The maximum dimension of the proposed tag is 21 x 21 mm, which covers the maximum number of fifteen bits. The proposed octagonal tag has more bit density of 3.4 bits/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a spectral bit density of 2.61 bits/GHz than the already published octagonal tags, which showed the proposed tag’s novelty. The proposed design can work for bits shifting, higher to lower or lower to a higher frequency. The covered bits lie in a UWB band range show the suitability for future medical and sensor applications.

articleTitle: Design of A Novel Microchannel-Based Device for Dielectrophoresis Separation of Cancer Cells From Red Blood Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: We present a novel microchannel-based device for separating cancer cells from red blood cells using dielectrophoresis for biosensor applications. The great point of our proposed device is the considerable low applied voltage to the electrode array for dielectrophoretic force generation, leading to the decrease in Joule heating effect and cell death. A numerical model was also developed to validate the device's working principle, examine particle focusing and separation behavior, and evaluate the separation efficiency. Using the unique structure, the numerical analysis results show that the required driving voltage is ten times smaller than the conventional channel. The obtained results provide a potential tool for a labon-a-chip system with outstanding advantages.

articleTitle: ELIS Behaviour for Students Using Internet and Social Networking Sites
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: As human communication is restricted due to physiological and physical condition, it needs telecommunications. One of modern telecommunications is social networking sites. Students who pursue their education outside their hometown often experience culture shock due to insufficient information. Therefore, they seek for information using internet and social media networking sites when trying to adapt to new situation. The purpose of this research is to find the interrelation between social demography, general information, media usage and everyday life seeking information, and to find out the effect of educational level on how the to fulfil their needs of daily information. This research will use quantitative approach with survey to 300 transnational students at some universities in big cities in Indonesia by using convenience and snowball sampling technique. The research result will be useful for institutions to provide the data of students using internet and social networking sites in handling information sources, information dissemination media, and information content which will affect to students’ academic performance.

articleTitle: Early Prediction on Electrical Energy Consumption in Households by using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Nowadays Machine Learning is widely used in various fields to perform a smart learning or predictions of a data, one of the methods in Machine Learning is Linear Regression. This research aims to examine the application of Machine Learning with the Linear Regression method programmed with Python Programming to predict electrical energy consumption in the next 30 days for prepaid and postpaid household electricity. Predictions were made based on data collected for 30 days, read through the PZEM-004T V3.0 sensor to measure electrical energy. The comparison experimental results sensor with measurement equipment have an average error of 2% energy reading or with a difference of 0.01 kWh every day for postpaid, and electrical energy consumption with a prediction range of 30 days on prepaid electricity types had an average error value of 1.21% or a difference of 3.68 kWh.

articleTitle: Formation Tracking Control Simulation of Multi Robot Systems for Omni-Wheels Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This paper introduces the formation of tracking control on the Omni Robot so that it can navigate according to a predetermined trajectory by tracing the trajectory. The main objective is to simulate a tracking formation control system on a holonomic robot. The approach used is Leader-Follower using PID control. Through an overview of the kinematics design of the Omni robot, PID control will be used to obtain and control the speed value of each robot to maintain a position distance and maintain its formation while navigating. The robot system was built using the ROS platform and gazebo simulation to simulate multi-robot formation tracking. An OpenBase model with three omnidirectional wheels was used for this simulation. In the simulation, there is 1 robot as Leader and 3 robots as Follower. In this paper, it can be seen that a robot with Omni wheels can move with a holonomic system on several paths. In straight and diagonal paths, the movement of the follower robot experiences a delay of 6-seconds from the leader robot. While on the "S" paths, the movement of the follower robot experiences a delay of 16-seconds from the leader robot.

articleTitle: Reliable Batik Image Classification : Mulwin-LBP Algorithm and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This study proposed feature extraction using the Mulwin-LBP algorithm which can optimally supported batik image classification activities. In this classification activity, the Deep Neural Network algorithm was used to provide solutions to the Invariant dilemma. However, previously, the image segmentation process using the Watershed method would be carried out to support the feature extraction. Actually this feature extraction algorithm is done by combining 3 and 4 different types of windows. The window sizes were used 6x6 pixel, 9x9 pixel, 12x12 pixel, and 15x15 pixel or a combination of 3 or 4 windows to get optimal and maximum results. Some experiments included the Training Images number more than the test image number, but the accuracy and precision of classification could reach more than 72.88%. Meanwhile, if the test was carried out by adding image classes, including the number of training images more than test images, the resulting classification accuracy had reached more than 81.65%. Even in other experiments with the number training images more than test images, the image conditions have the same rotation but different scales, for classification accuracy had reached more than 93.68% with a total of 12 classes. Even if the drawing class studied is only 10 classes, the accuracy had reached more than 98%. The reliability of this algorithm in supporting batik image classification can continue to be improved in further research.

articleTitle: An Experimental of Xbee Communication Performance for Forest Fires Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Forests are the lungs of the earth because the plants in them can produce oxygen. Forests in Indonesia are also one of the lungs of the earth. The total area of forest fires reported by each region in Indonesia in 2019 was recorded at 1649258 hectares. The forest fire monitoring system is an important part of handling forest fires. One way to directly monitor forest fires is to use a forest fire monitoring robot with a telemetry system. Xbee Pro S3B on-board can communicate with other Xbee module at ground station by receiving data obtained from sensors with faster rate, minimal data loss and high range. In this research, researcher will be find maximum range of system communication, maximum delay, and minimum average for 10 times transfer data from the sensor to the server maximum range of system communication can send the data in the Line of Sight area in about 588 meters, The maximum delay for 10 times transfers data is about 12.805 millisecond, with minimum average for 10 times transfer data in about 8.734 millisecond. Data in the forest area measurement can reach the maximum range of in about 358 meters, and maximum delay for 10 times transfer data is about 12.806 millisecond, with minimum average for 10 times transfer data in about 5.795 millisecond. Data in the building area measurement can reach the maximum range of in about 382 meters and maximum delay for 10 times transfer data is about 12.806 millisecond, with minimum average for 10 times transfer data in about 6077 milliseconds. The biggest error of distance measurement from GPS data compared by Google maps data is 12.2 %

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Functionally Graded Materials and It’s Potentials for Battery Application : A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Solid-state lithium-ion batteries (SSBs) have great potential for future energy storage due to their high energy and power density. Replacing liquid with solid electrolyte could give a solution for safety issues because the solid electrolyte has good mechanical strength. Although SSBs have promising potentials, SSBs have several new issues in current development. The crack appearances during charge/discharge of SSBs can affect electrochemical performance. The continuous volume changes of both anode and cathode during lithiation/delithiation cause high cycle of pressure change during operation of SSBs. High cyclic pressure initiates crack emerged in the interface between electrode and electrolyte. Crack propagation that occurs causes impedance and would affect electrochemical performance. Researchers are devoted to researching functionally graded materials (FGM), which can solve many problems. Many numerical simulations and analyses of FGM have already been done, such as micromechanical FEM modeling, thermal stresses, bending analysis, and free vibration responses. However, studies for numerical simulation of FGM in battery applications are still limited. Numerical simulation of FGM on battery application is essential to predict battery performance. With the development of FGM application on SSBs, there is a promising prospect to apply the numerical simulation analysis of FGM on electrodes to know the FGM properties in SSBs application. Furthermore, in future research of FGM SSBs application, FGM is not only applied on the electrode, but also applied on both electrode and electrolyte.

articleTitle: Development of Virtual Multimeter in Determining Diode Characteristics Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: In general, measuring electronic circuits can only use ordinary measuring tools or manually. But as technology develops, measuring electrical circuits does not only use manual tools but can already use LabVIEW software. A measuring instrument with a dc voltage sensor was developed using an Arduino and a dc current sensor using an INA219 sensor. This data is then processed into digital data by Arduino and then entered the measurement interface programmed with LabVIEW so that current and voltage values can be displayed both on DC and AC sources. To characterize the diode, a DC voltage and current reading test is carried out first. The DC voltage reading on the LabVIEW interface has an error of 3.3% or a reading accuracy of 96.67%, while the DC current reading has an error of 7.2% reading the measurement value or a reading accuracy of 92.78%. From this virtual multimeter, a diode characterization system was developed by applying a current and voltage measuring circuit when forward biased. The current and voltage measurement data are combined at the same time and then plotted on the interface. The display on the interface is compared with the same data but plotted using excel. The results of the diode characterization were carried out at room temperature of 25° C shows the built-in potential for a silicon diode of about 0.6 V and a germanium diode of 0.3 V.

articleTitle: Simulation and Modelling of a Brushless DC Motor Using the MATLAB/ SIMULINK Application Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: For applications in which speed and power are regulated simultaneously, the brushless DC motors (BLDCM) are capable of maintaining a constant speed. This motor is impressive as compared to the DC motors, is able to develop much more power and work at the same time. Involuntary work was examined during this study, including the rate at which an open-loop BLDCM output grows, with hardware support, and also a three-segment strategy on closed-loop BLDCM. The pulse width (or duty) may be modified to adjust the intensity in open-loop circuit characteristics, and input voltage may be used to expand or decrease the motor's speed. MATLAB/ SIMULINK was fatigued to simulate the Open Loop three parts of the BLDCM. During this study, the speed of several pulses and the simulations are compared with the hardware well as pulse widths are seen.

articleTitle: Development of BLENODE32 Practicum Module Using ADDIE for Embedded System & IoT Practical Work
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Nowadays, teaching methods must adapt and take advantage of the latest technological developments. Besides, COVID–19 pandemic has disrupted learning activities and changed the way of education simultaneously to distance education. However, in distance education, some obstacles must be faced, the material learning must convey adequately, and students must get the entire learning experience. It is known that there is a need for embedded systems and IoT courses where learning activities during the pandemic should not face disruption. So, to meet the learning needs, especially during the pandemic, it is necessary to innovate and use relevant technology for the learning and teaching process, such as making distance learning media. These research aims are to develop a practicum module for BLENode32 trainers and to know the user response from the developed practicum module. This research uses qualitative methods with the ADDIE (Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, and Evaluation) approach. The respondents in this research were 31 students of electrical engineering education. Based on the result, it is known that most participants gave a significant positive response to the use of the learning module of BLENode32.

articleTitle: Analysis of MPPT Output Results Based on P&O-Fuzzy and Flow Changes Combination Compared to Classic P&O Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Many studies related to energy production efficiency of PV applications have been carried out. The main objective of the development of photovoltaic is to optimize the energy generated by photovoltaic in order to aqcuire optimal electrical power, particularly in environments of very low radiation. This study aims to improve an existing P&O algorithm in order to obtain a more optimal energy output and boost the system in determining the maximum power point in PV. The combination of P&O algorithm and fuzzy algorithm is a decent method in optimizing PV energy. The P&O Algorithm theme was chosen because it characterizes as a simple structure and is easy to comprehend, while the fuzzy algorithm has a very fast response and produces notable output. The development of this algorithm is simulated into matlab simulink. The results of the analysis are taken from the comparison of the output of the classic P&O algorithm with fuzzy P&O algorithm. The results include output voltage (V), flow (I), response time, overshoot voltage, and power efficiency.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based on Viola-Jones Algorithm as Dataset for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Face detection is the first step in the face recognition system to identify the entire image area to find facial areas and non-face areas. The face recognition process can be known through the position and distance of the face from the camera. The Viola-Jones and HOG algorithms have good accuracy in facial recognition. This is evident from the experimental results obtained that face recognition using this algorithm has a recognition ability of 98.9%. This algorithm can also be used to create a dataset from an image. In this study, image classification was performed using three models, that is Naive Bayes, random forest, and logistic regression. The dataset used comes from facial recognition performed with Viola-Jones and HOG. The result obtained from this face classification is that the logistic regression model has the highest level of accuracy because it can classify all images perfectly. The Naive Bayes model has one error in image classification, and the random forest model has three errors in image classification.

articleTitle: A Sign Language Recognition System Using Ionic Liquid Strain Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: In this report, we develop a system converting sign language into voices and text. The system includes a glove attached self-developed ionic liquid-based strain sensors on each finger to detect the movement of them. When the hand move to express a letter lead to the resistance of the strain sensors on each finger change. Therefore, through the information from set of sensors, the system can recognize the letter that user want to convey. A measuring and data acquisition circuit also are developed to receive and analyze data from the sensors. Furthermore, a data digitizing method is proposed as a solution for decoding purpose. The system is tested with 10 distinguished basic letters in American Sign Language table (ASL). The results show the accuracy of system is 98%. The system operates stably with the low power of 0.81W at rest state and 1.71W when working. Besides, applications on smartphone and PC are also built to translate the data into text and speech. These apps make it easier to communicate with deaf people. With achieved results, the system is fully extensible to detect more letters in ALS table in the future.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Method of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastic with Artificial Damages for Evaluating Electrical Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a method to manufacture carbon fiber reinforced polymer composite with artificial damages for evaluating electrical behaviors. The damages include micro-damages, i.e., fiber breaks and delaminations. The composite contained four layers of twill woven carbon fiber and epoxy resin. Vacuum bag method was implemented to create the composite. Fiber breaks were created by cutting fibers prior to being immersed by resin. Furthermore, plastic plates were tucked in the composite layer interface to create artificial delamination. After the vacuum bag process, the composite was cut to be several specimens. The fiber waiving and the distance among composite layers were then investigated. In addition, electrode plates were pasted on the composite surfaces. These electrode plates were used for injecting electric current to obtain the composite resistance indicating the appearance of artificial damages in the composite. The proposed manufacturing process of composite with artificial damages shows good results in which the damages can be fully controlled in terms of geometry and size.

articleTitle: Electronic Structure And Linear Optical Properties Of Ta-Doped TiO2
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Electronic structure of anatase TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doped with Ta is investigated using density function theory and fullpotential linearized augmented plane wave method (FLAPW). Specifically, the band structure and total density of states are investigated and compared with the pure TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Linear optical property, specifically dielectric function, is also investigated. Results of the calculations shows that Ta-doped TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has dopant states near the conduction bands and slightly metallic behavior. The dielectric function of Ta-doped TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> also shows combination of semiconducting and metallic features, especially at low photon frequency.

articleTitle: IoT Based Monitoring System of Moss Terrarium Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to develop a monitoring system for terrarium moss cultivation. The parameters measured were air temperature, humidity and soil moisture or planting media from terrarium moss. These three parameters can affect the quality of terrarium moss because the moss is seen from its aesthetic value so that it has a fairly high economic value. These three parameters will be measured and sent and displayed on a web application so that measurements can be carried out in real-time. The system can provide warnings to users so that users can carry out maintenance on the required cultivation media.

articleTitle: The Effect of Micro Damages to Mechanical and Electrical Behaviors of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer: a Review
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This paper presents a brief review of the effect of micro damages in carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) on its mechanical and electrical behavior. CFRP composites offer strength and stiffness properties in the longitudinal direction, but they will quickly develop cracks along the fibers. There are three types of micro damages in the composite: fiber breakage, matrix cracking, and interfacial debonding. The role of these damages can be investigated by conducting multiscale modeling. The representational volume element (RVE) and the repeating unit cell (RCU) approach will be applied at a specific location by multiscale elements and run parallel to global analysis. The idea is to create a model in each scale (macro, meso, and micro scales) so that the model can be connected. For mechanical behavior, the damage appearance directly correlates with mechanical properties drop, which may be dangerous when the composite is applied as load-bearing structures. Considering the carbon fiber has high conductivity, the composite can also be used as a sensor for detecting crack appearance, applicable for structural health monitoring. In this case, the electrical behavior must be evaluated carefully before the implementation. One of the remaining issues for the application is understanding the effects of micro damages on electrical behavior. Several efforts to solve this issue are explained in this paper. Understanding the relationship between these damages to the behaviors can be useful to develop technology that improves the crack resistance of CFRP composites, preventing or delaying matrix cracking and delamination.

articleTitle: Attendance System on Moving Objects through Face Recognition using MTCNN and CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Face detection and recognition using the eigenfaces method accuracy is decreased when there are changes in object distance and lighting levels. The objective of this research is to propose an automatic presence system through face detection using the MTCNN method and facial image recognition using the CNN method. The CNN architecture used in this study is VGG16. Based on the test results, the MTCNN and CNN algorithm can handle the changes in object distance and lighting levels. The face detection system has an average error value of 17%, calculated using MAPE; the error rate is high because other objects cover faces, and some faces use face-covering attributes. The facial recognition system has an average accuracy value of 78% for the first architecture and 87.3% for the second architecture.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Sensor Network Programming Tutorial Module (WSNmesh32)
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The use of Internet of Things technology may have a significant impact on changes in online learning systems in the situation of the COVID-19 pandemic. Learners need a laboratory to use and master the necessary tools or components. However, this is difficult to do in a pandemic situation. The use of remote laboratories can overcome the limitations of practicum media, which is an obstacle for students in learning. This research discusses the creation of WSNMesh32 programming tutorial modules as microcontrollers using Wi-Fi-mesh network topology that can be used in Sensor and Microcontroller Practicum courses. This research aims to find out the feasibility and perception of learners towards the WSNMesh32 Programming Tutorial Module as a learning medium in pandemic times. The method used is a quantitative method with the ADDIE model (Analyse, Design, Develop, Implement, Evaluation). Participants consisted of 31 students of the Electrical Engineering Education study program of the Industrial Electronics division 2018. The study was conducted online in light of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic situation. The feasibility test of the module is carried out by leading discussions and reviews with experts on the material to be presented. Respondents gave a positive response to the module. The results provide the conclusion that the sensor programming tutorial module that has been produced is suitable for use as a tutorial module in sensor and microcontroller practicum courses and can be used in learning in a pandemic situation

articleTitle: Implementation of Inverse Kinematics in Design of Six-Degree of Freedoms Platform for Hardware in the Loop Simulation on Quadcopter Drones
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: In order to minimize, long setup preparation period, high cost, and flexibility of varying test parameters during trial for testing and developing real quad-copter drones, it is required to design Hardware in The Loop Simulation (HIL) testing. To simulate the reality it is necessary to build a test system in the HIL to replace the drone. Because the drone has six-Degree of Freedoms (six DOF's) the test system should have six DOF's as well. In this paper, the six DOF test systems will then be called six DOF platforms. The platform movements are driven by six rotary actuators using servomotors. The movements are generated by implementing the inverse kinematics method. Platform testing results respectively average errors in pitch, roll, yaw, X, Y, and Z movements of 2.8%, 3.7%, 3.6%, 8.9%, 8.8%, and 3.8%. These results show that six DOF platforms can be used as a simulator for HIL on quad-copter drones.

articleTitle: Concentration Detection of Continuous-Flow Magnetic Nanoparticles Using Giant Magnetoresistance Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Giant magnetoresistance (GMR) sensors offer great sensitivity and integration capabilities on devices, especially microfluidic systems. This approach allows fast identification and real-time analysis of the detection of the biomolecules conjugated with the magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs), which are essential requirements for biomedical applications. This study integrated the GMR sensor with microchannel and signal processing circuits to determine MNPs concentration in a continuous flow using Helmholtz magnetic field source. The most significant advantage of this technique consists of modifying and integrating the GMR sensor to enhance the output signal and the system’s sensitivity at a shallow concentration of MNPs. The high sensitivity was experimentally determined as 3.018V/(mg.mL<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) with a low detection limit (LOD) of about 19 μg.mL<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. This proposed system is appropriate to integrate into point-of-care microfluidic devices to detect biomolecule concentrations in real-time diagnostics.

articleTitle: Hybrid Certainty Factor and Dempster Shafer to Diagnose Shallot Disease in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Agriculture sector in Indonesia, especially the shallot commodity, is still problematic with many cases of farmers failing to harvest. Of the many causes of crop failure, one of the causes is disease in plants which is very difficult to predict. This will be very detrimental not only to shallot farmers, the community will also be affected by the increase in the price of shallot in the market due to decreased production due to crop failure. So that diseases in shallot plants can be detected early, an expert system is made. This paper proposed hybrid method of Dempster-Shafer and Certainty Factor methods which are suiTable for disease expert systems. Experimental result shows that the two methods can also collaborate each other to produce more accurate disease diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Development of Technopreneur Training Models Using Internet of Things (IoT)-Based Smart Healthcare System for UPI Students
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The use of Internet of Things technology is increasingly popular in the world health industry. This innovation allows health care devices to be connected to the internet network, so that patient data can be updated and accessed in real-time. One example is a bed equipped with a patient's blood pressure, heart rate, and temperature measurement, and connected via the cloud to a guard post. nurse. Continuous data monitoring with Internet of Things technology will become a platform in the health industry, enabling doctors to quickly and effectively diagnose patient health. The patient monitoring system in real time will send monitored data directly into the network to the internet. Early detection of disease is possible by using the IoT application on Smart Healthcare before consulting or treating with a doctor. Internet of Things healthcare has a wide range of applications such as heart monitoring, ECG monitoring, blood pressure monitoring, etc. Utilization of Internet of Things in the smart healthcare industry will help patients to monitor health remotely, reduce health costs, doctors have more data on patients and can track patients' health status from home. Seeing the development of Internet of Things technology and its development opportunities, it is hoped that through Community Service based on Entrepreneurship activities, students can create creative and innovative works in the field of technologybased entrepreneurship that can provide opportunities to create young entrepreneurs from Indonesian University of Education students.

articleTitle: Retrofitting a Conventional Lathe Machine Type BV20-1L to a Semi CNC Lathe Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Retrofit is one of methods to apply new technology and functionality in improving the performance and security of outdated systems. The application of retrofit can be done on conventional lathes because the machining process takes a long time. Furthermore in the operation of this conventional lathe the results of the work piece depend on the ability of the operator so the results are less consistent. Therefore, there is an innovation to this lathe that can control it automatically. The process of retrofitting this lathe used two stepper motors to move the carriage on the X axis (diameter feeding) and Z (depth of cut). The stepper motor is driven by TB6600 driver module that will be controlled via raspberry pi 3 B+ with python programming language. The Control and monitoring process of cut tool movements can be done through the interface that has been created using the LabVIEW 2020 application. There were two tests conducted, namely step work piece feeding testing and average total delay testing. Testing of the feeding of the work piece is carried out using the type of aluminum material as work piece. Based on the results of the test of the feeding of the work piece called Step, it came to the conclusion that the accuracy rate on the X axis is 99.37% and on the Z axis is 98.68%. The different accuracy rate is caused by the mechanical backlash and the quality of DDA program. Testing on the delay time process depicts that the average delay value is around 11.7 seconds.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Concept for Reservation System in Trainer Kit Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has an impact on changes in human lifestyles, one of the aspects affected is the field of education where students are encouraged to take part in learning activities from home. The teacher also has to come up with a new learning strategy, especially for practicum. One of the solutions is to create a trainer kit that can be accessed remotely. In Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia this solution would be implemented. But along the trials of the trainer kit we’ve facing trouble to identify who’s using the trainer. To verify the student is the one who’s using the trainer, we come up with a solution to implement a face recognition system. The system is implemented on a web application integrated with the reservation system. The results of this additional feature can bring more certainty to the learning process. Furthermore, it has proven to distinguish and recognize students’ identities by storing their faces as a sample. The local test has shown a significant performance on how this system can work by making 7 out of 10 correct face recognition.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Modul box For Production Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Production data information that is carried out automatically without human intervention is very important. This is necessary so that the desired efficiency and productivity can be achieved. To create a quality IoT-based production monitoring system, the author has conducted research on IoT-based production system monitoring tools using raspberry PI 3 and firebase real time database. Even though this tool has the reliability to send production data, there are still various errors in the data retrieval process such as unsent production data, data damage when the connection is unstable, modul box cannot detect parts that are being produced, modul box cannot run the main program automatically, in addition to connection and data transmission problems, other problems lie with the website, also only uses three accounts to enter the website, namely management, engineers, and operators Therefore, it is necessary to optimize various monitoring tools for production systems based on internet of things, including optimization of data delivery when the connection is unstable, developing hardware designs, adding detection mechanisms for parts that are being produced. The result of the research that has been made is a tool in the form of a Modul box which has a main controller, namely the raspberry pi 3 and a website that can be used to monitor the production system, this tool has a portable form so that it is easy to remove and move and can be connected to a PLC, sensors, or relays on production machines.

articleTitle: Identifying SCADA Network Security Through Network Reconnaissance and Firewall Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Along with technological advances, hacking techniques are growing rapidly which are generally used to perform Cyberattacks. Cyberattacks can be performed by irresponsible parties with extracting information, attacking and sabotaging vulnerable systems such as SCADA system networks in the industry. Network reconnaissance and firewall filter are methods that can use as a SCADA network security test. These methods include performing various port scanning techniques, intrusion detection, and blocking intrusion attempts. Various port scanning techniques can be detected and SCADA devices can be protected using a firewall filter. In this experiment, network reconnaissance and firewall filters are proven to improve SCADA network security.

articleTitle: Enhanced Light Absorptivity by Designing 2D Photonic Crystals on Lead Iodide based Perovskite Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSC) is one of the third generation solar cell that manage to compete with silicon solar cells in only a few years of development. Not only the efficiency trend, but also PSC have a low-cost manufacturing. In order to enhance the efficiency, the optical improvement is become important. Photonic crystals (PC) are one of the optical solutions to enhance the absorptivity of solar cells. The characteristics of PC such as "slow photon"and straightening of light effect is useful to reduce the recombination and strengthen the interaction between photon and material. In this work, a two dimension of nanodisk photonic crystal is applied to electron transport layer in methylamine lead iodide (CH3NH3PbI3, or MAPbI3) based PSC. The design is made in simulation with FDTD methods.It is found that the absorptivity of PSC with ideal design of PC is increased about 9% than flat PSC.

articleTitle: Creating E-Modules Basic Electricity And Electronic Courses Based On Wordpress For Vocational School Students
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The Covid-19 pandemic that hit all countries in the world, including Indonesia, made the government implement various policies, one of which was in the field of education, namely the implementation of a distance learning system to prevent the spread of Covid-19. This learning system requires the development of learning media that can be accessed remotely. The basic e-module of electricity and electronics is a distance learning medium designed to allow students to learn the material independently even though the teacher has not explained it. E-Modules can be an alternative learning media as a substitute for conventional books during the Covid-19 pandemic. This E-Module is based on WordPress. So that this E-Module can be accessed on multiple devices, starting from the Android, iOS, tablet, and laptop versions of smartphones. The features displayed on the E-module consist of learning materials, student assignments, student attendance, quizzes, learning videos, and technical info. In addition, the features and content displayed can be tailored to the needs of students. Problems faced by vocational students during the Covid-19 pandemic can be solved by applying distance learning media because using distance learning media can reduce virus transmission and can be accessed anytime and anywhere without having to rely on school hours.

articleTitle: BOBzBT2 organic pentamer for the observation of resistive switching mechanism and strong coupling regime
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: We introduce a novel organic pentamer, 1,4-bis[2(5-thiophen-2-yl)-1-benzothiophene]-2,5dioctyloxybenzene (BOBzBT2) that can be used to observe two interesting electrical and optical phenomena, namely, the resistive switching mechanism and the strong coupling regime. The stability of the pentamer, resulted from the addition of dioctyloxy-substituents along with its elongated π-conjugation backbones, allows us to induce the resistive switching mechanism on a commercially screen-printed electrode (SPE) strip. On the other hand, the addition of thiophene units in the pentamer enhanced its optical nonlinearities and the presence of bis-donor groups and contributed to a large efficiency of two-photon absorption yield. As a result, we were able to demonstrate a room temperature strong coupling regime with a large Rabi splitting using surface plasmon resonance (SPR)-Otto configuration.

articleTitle: Penetration Level Limited of Single and Multiple DG Siting and Sizing using PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Optimal placement of distributed generation (DG) in the distribution system can minimize the active power loss and improve bus voltages. However, should the DG be placed in a centralizing location or at multiple locations so that the performance of the distribution network will become better? This paper proposes the optimization placement of single and multiple DG in the radial distribution system (RDS) using the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method by sconsidering the objective function of minimizing total active power loss and voltage profile improvement with the constraint of DG penetration level. The range of DG penetration level is set to be 0-60% of the total load. The effectiveness of the proposed method will be implemented and tested on IEEE 33 bus test system for both case studies. It was found that the multi DGs placement of 4 DGs in the system has a better improving rate of voltage and higher loss reduction when compared to without DG, single DG, and 2 DGs placement. The proposed method is useful for grid planning who require simple and fast determination of DG optimal location with various DG penetration level.

articleTitle: Model Validation of Brushed DC Motor Based on NI ELVIS II as a Teaching Aid
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: DC motor is one type of actuator which is still widely used in control technology both in industry and in households. DC motors have a fast response but can be tricked by controlling the system to produce maximum response Control generally uses PID control. To design the desired response can be done by simulation using a mathematical model that has been validated to represent the DC motor system well. Therefore, students need to be supported by interactive learning media with DC motor validation systems to improve abilities and competencies. This final project aims to design a model validation system of brushed dc motor as an interactive learning media. This model validation system uses LabVIEW as interface software and NI ELVIS II as controller hardware and system data acquisition. This final project produces a mechanical construction with two identical motors whose parameters will identify. Parameters to be searched are armature coil resistance, Rm, armature coil inductance, La, motor torque constant, Km, moment inertia, J, and viscous damping friction, B. Rm and La were determined from the static test, Km, B, and J determined from the dynamic test. The minimum RMSE value of the model validity occurs at a voltage of 3-12V with an RMSE value below 10%. The results of the questionnaire show that the respondents gave a score of 80% regarding the quality of the overall system interface. In addition, the interface of the DC motor model validation system is considered feasible to be used as a teaching aid.

articleTitle: System Design Of Adaptive Oxygen Flow Control using the Fuzzy Logic Method For Oxygen Therapy Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Oxygen is one of the components of gas which is a vital element in the metabolic process. Lack of oxygen can cause metabolism to occur imperfectly, causing the death of tissues and even life-threatening. Weaning the oxygen therapy is a solution to overcome this lack of oxygen. Medical personnel usually use this method as a medicine in an emergency conditions.This study aims to design an adaptive oxygen flow rate control and design an interface on an oxygen therapy device. The MAX30100 sensor is used to read oxygen saturation data, and the MLX90614 sensor is used as a source for processing the patient's respiration rate. Oxygen flow is controlled using fuzzy logic programmed in the microcontroller, and the sensor reading and processing data will be displayed on the Nextion interface. Furthermore, in testing the prototype, the use of the MAX30100 sensor and the MLX90614 sensor as a detector of the patient's condition has been able to control the oxygen flow rate that follows the oxygen flow requirement that needs to be given to the patient. In addition, the fuzzy system can produce an output value that matches the value of the given input with an average error of less than 2%, and besides that, the accuracy of the testing of the respiration rate reached a value of 93.70% on the prototype.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Wind Energy Conversion System to Electricity On The Coast of Kebumen
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: National Energy Policy (KEN) and Paris Agreement is an energy transition step in Indonesia towards using new and renewable energy. Wind energy conversion system development (SKEA) technology is quite large. These developments include power electronics technology in turbines and generators. Focus on this research to utilize power electronics technology to produce ideal voltages on the coast of the Kebumen district. The data obtained from NASA satellites show the average speed in July is 1.75 m/s and in August is 1.65 m/s. From this speed, wind energy is converted into electrical energy that can be utilized by the people of Kebumen district by using electronic power devices. Wind energy conversion using converter controller in which there is a rectifier circuit, boost converter, and inverter to produce high power will be used by the community on the coast of the district Kebumen. The higher the wind speed, the greater the power generated. At a wind speed of 1 m/s, the generator speed is three rad/s, and when the wind speed is increased to 5 m/s, the generator speed increases to 17 rad/s. Assuming that the speed is stable at five m/s, the results obtained from the converter are 125 vdc and a current of 23 A and the power generated is 2875 Watts. The output of the converter controller requires a filter circuit to obtain an ideal and stable voltage of 220 Volts with a phase difference of 120 and a frequency of 50 Hz.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Microcantilever based Biosensor for Detection of Human Immunodeficiency Virus
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This paper presents the effect of a microcantilever beam biosensor size on deflection using SU8 material. This design is optimized for detecting Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) molecules in the human body. The microcantilever is designed as a thin beam, it consists SU8 square diaphragm anchored by four SU8 cantilevers, so to find the optimal microcantilever geometry, the cantilever’s length and width are varied, in the range of length 200-400 μm, width 75-175 μm, and thickness is set at 3 μm. Meanwhile, the diaphragm size was set at 505 μm × 505 μm × 3 μm. This MEMS-based cantilever beam design was designed using COMSOL Multiphysics software. The geometric dimensions with the best deflection that can be used in microcantilever biosensor applications are when the length is 400 µm, the width is 75 µm, and the thickness is 3 µm, which give a displacement of 3.08 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> μm. Meanwhile, the relationship between the microcantilever size and the displacement is directly proportional, as the number of bound particles increases, the displacement also increases, and short and narrow cantilevers show higher displacement.

articleTitle: Supervisory System Based on Image Processing Using Library Open Computer Vision In Tool Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Currently, the supervisor of the availability of work tools in the tool management system is still done manually by the laboratory assistant in charge of recording the process of borrowing and returning work tools. However, there is already an automatic work tool detection system based on image processing. However, the system created often still has various errors in the detection results because there is often a decrease in the level of accuracy. This final project aims to improve the ability of open computer vision, which can replace human visual functions to support detection results to increase the accuracy of system performance with parameters of light intensity, camera distance, and work tool position. The development of the computer vision library is carried out using you only look once (YOLO) method to achieve an accurate tool management system and supported by room restrictions using automatic doors that can identify the users' identity. The result of the final project that has been made is that it can develop the performance of open computer vision to improve the accuracy of the detection system with an average accuracy value of 91%. The plan that has been made can be realized to record borrowing and returning transactions for work tools automatically and a website that can be used to provide information on the availability of work tools.

articleTitle: Optimization of SVC Placement With Genetic Algorithms Using Matlab’s at 150kV Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: In the electric power system, voltage profile improvement is needed to reduce power losses that often occur. Tools that are widely used to improve this voltage profile include SVC (static var compensator) which is a component of FACTS (Flexible Alternating Current Transmission Systems). The purpose of this study is to determine the optimal location and capacity of the SVC, as well as to determine the effect of installing SVC. This research was conducted on a 150 KV transmission system in the load control area of West Java, the subsystem of south Bandung and New Ujung Berung because there are still buses whose voltage exceeds the IEEE standard, namely 0.95 pu to 1.05 pu. The research method used for power flow simulation is Newton Raphson and genetic algorithm in MATLAB R2014 to determine the optimal location and capacity of the SVC. The results show that the optimal SVC placement uses an algorithm that is placed on North Bandung buses with a rating of -70.5 MVAR and 70.5 MVAR, Cianjur buses with a -62.19 MVAR and 62.19 rating and Rancaekek buses with a - 193.53 MVAR and 193.53 MVAR rating. After optimizing the SVC layout, the system performance is improved i.e. all bus voltages are at IEEE standard levels and power losses are decreased.

articleTitle: Redistribution of Wealth: An Agent-based Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Without any doubt, the Covid-19 pandemic would have a long and lasting impact globally economically. The pandemic would increase the Gini index, a measure of income inequality, remarkably. The previous pandemics due to H1N1 in 2009, Ebola in 2014, and Zika in 2016 increased the index by 1.5 points, according to the World-Bank report issued in 2020. The income gap that has constantly been growing would accelerate with the pandemic. Income inequality often leads to social unrest, lower economic growth, increased health cost, and a lower level of satisfaction. This research studies how a taxation strategy affects the Gini index. We use an agent-based model and the yardsale model, where a small number of agents is established in a closed simulation world. The simulation world has conversed in the total wealth and the number of agents. Each agent performs a wealth exchange of a small amount with other randomly selected agents for each time instant. The simulation results suggest a critical tax rate such that the wealth distribution and Gini index are sustainable. A tax rate lower than the compulsory rate leads to a continuous increase in the simulation time’s income inequality trend. On the other side, a tax rate higher than the critical rate reduces the wealth distribution gap. We study various taxation rates and find a vital taxation rate to maintain the wealth distribution. If the tax rate is lower than the critical, the wealth distribution will become more expansive, and otherwise, a higher tax rate would shrink the wealth distribution.

articleTitle: System Design of Virtual Microcontroller Laboratory Based on the Over The Air Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Practicum has become a crucial part of engineering education, but also in the allied subject ones. Due to developments in electronics, microcontroller-based devices are found in all aspects of everyday life. To resolve this problem, it is necessary to design a microcontroller trainer kit with a remote control system and interactive interface as a learning tool. Furthermore, the system uses the concept of a virtual lab with a remotely triggered lab type on a web platform. The technique which is used as a technique to download or overwrite the microcontroller program is the over the air programming (OTA) technique. Moreover, users are intended to perform the microcontroller practicum, controlling the I/O available on the trainer kit. OTA programming testing on microcontroller devices was successfully conducted consecutively with five experiments with different program documents. In addition, live streaming delay testing was successfully carried out with an average delay of 3.6 seconds. Finally, the result of the system interface testing from questionnaires showed that respondents rated 87% regarding the overall quality of the interface.

articleTitle: Interface for Quadcopter Drone Physical Model Hardware in the Loop (HIL)
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: This electronic document deals with the interface for a Hardware in the Loop Simulation of a flight microcontroller called Pixhawk. The interface in this Quadcopter drone Physical Model Hardware in the Loop is needed for communication between several devices. Simulation results are given to show the responses from Unit Under Test which in this system is Pixhawk.

articleTitle: Developing Human Movement Monitoring System using HAAR Cascade Classifier Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Walking speed is widely used as the material for research studies in the health sector, especially for early detection of someone who is healthy or sick. The existence of a monitoring system will greatly help a company to detect the health of its workers early. In this paper, an algorithm for calculating a person’s walking speed is developed. This study uses HAAR Cascade Classifier as pedestrian detection and the process of image processing is performed with the help of the OpenCV library. The test results show that the system successfully detects humans both indoors and outdoors in dim lighting conditions (in the afternoon) and bright (during the day). Based on the test results, the system has successfully detected both single-object and multi-object human objects with accuracy in calculating running speed in the range of 86%.

articleTitle: Development of a Low-Delivery-Rate Triple Syringe Infusion Pump for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: Micromixing is promisingly becoming more important in many chemical and biological applications. Syringe pump has a considerable impact on the efficiency of microfluidic micromixing devices which are extremely useful for delivering a precise amount of a substance at specific periods. This study proposes the development of a low-cost working prototype of a syringe pump for variable and low delivery rates in the administration of small volumes. The presented multi-channel low-delivery-rate syringe infusion pump employs a lead-screw mechanism driven by stepper motors. There is provision for multiple flow rate controls, safety features, and wireless device control. When used with a 1 ml syringe, the syringe pump is observed to work at various flow rates, demonstrating that the system can be used in medical settings to control the volume and flow rate of chemical fluids, as well as with microfluidic mixing studies in particular and scientific research, the biomedical field in general. The experimental results in the design and manufacture of the mechanical assembly demonstrated the ability to modify the proposed design as needed in the related scientific and industrial area, letting off the dependency on producers from different components of the world.

articleTitle: Design of an STM32 EduTrainer Board For Industrial Application
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: The development of training modules based on microcontrollers is experiencing growth where currently the capabilities of a module must be at least the same as those in the industry and can be applied directly. One of the chip platforms that is expected to improve performance in the industrial world is the STM32 where this chip produced by ST Microelectronics has a high clock frequency, generally in the lowest range of 72MHz or more so it is clearly faster and more powerful. but there are different voltage levels between the microprocessor and the voltage level in the industry where in the industrial world the voltage level is 0-24 volts while the microcontroller has a voltage level of 0 - 3.3 volts, in this paper a main board has been designed which is powered by the STM32F103RET microcontroller and equipped with industrial Shield which allows the GPIO to communicate with industry standard voltage levels (0 and 24V) as well as industrial analog voltage levels 0-10v and current levels 0-20mA.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Functionally Graded Material for Solid State Battery Application
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: A solid-state battery is classified as a new battery technology generation with low potential hazards and high energy storage capacity. Even though the safety and capacity are excellent, the appearance of cracks at the solid electrode-solid electrolyte interface during both charging and discharging processes is still the main problem. Functionally Graded Material (FGM) is a strong candidate to substitute conventional solid materials of the battery constituents because it can significantly reduce the crack appearance due to dismissing the interface, which directly increases the reliability of the solid-state battery. This paper demonstrates finite element analysis of solid electrode-solid electrolyte FGM under tensile load. The FGM model was developed and simulated using a predefined field in Abaqus 2020 software to form a mechanical properties gradation. The model was examined numerically with various properties gradation numbers. The simulation results show that the FGM model with a larger gradation number generates a smoother stress distribution than a smaller one. Stress concentrations occur at fewer gradations with maximum stress at 1403 MPa; this becomes a source of crack initiation. The potential application of FGM for solid-state batteries (SSB) is then comprehensively discussed.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Thermal Face Recognition Based on Haar Wavelet Transform (HWT) and Histogram of Gradient (HoG)
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: A comprehensive evaluation of the visual features applied to the proposed face recognition method on thermal images is presented. Comparative performance analysis is carried out on two different features which includes Histogram of Gradients (HoG), and Haar Wavelet Transform (HWT) plus Principle Component Analysis (PCA), resulting two different classifiers which include Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Multi-Layer Perception (MLP) is conducted. The comparisons are made for the following cases. Case-1 feature extraction (HoG) and classify (SVM), Case-2 feature extraction (HoG) and classify (MLP), Case-3 feature extraction (HWT & PCA) and classify (SVM), and Case-4 feature extraction (HWT & PCA) and classify (MLP). The face recognition experiments were carried out and compared by using python programming. The image dataset has 4400 images obtained from 15 subjects of various ages and genders recorded by the IR-BF503 thermal camera with several head poses, occlusions and illuminations. The performance of the face recognition method is measured based on the MSE, PNSR, bit rate, ratio, and time compression, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The purpose of this method comparison is to find a suitable method for facial recognition which is used to measure body temperature and heart rate. Finally, the algorithm implemented to case-4 showed a good performance due to its highest accuracy, F1 score, and recall.

articleTitle: Indonesian Gen Z Perception to Smartwatch: A Uses and Gratification Analysis of A Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
abstract: A smartwatch is a wearable device that complements a smartphone. However, in Indonesia, it is more prevalent among Gen Y, while Gen Z is the largest generation and market today. The purpose of this study was to determine Gen Z’s perception of smartwatches because the information obtained can help improve the function, quality, and design of the smartwatch to adapt to Gen Z. The method used in this study is a qualitative method with a phenomenological design. Data collection was carried out by interviewing 106 Gen Z in Indonesia who know about smartwatches. Although most informants have never used a smartwatch, the study results show that they expressed positive opinions and perceptions about smartwatches. Most of Gen Z interprets that a smartwatch is a device that can support their daily activities, especially in communicating, sports activities, monitoring health, driving activities, and supporting appearance. Gen Z shows high hopes for the features of smartwatches that will suit their "personalized" character and needs; therefore, even those who have never used them are interested in using smartwatches in the future. Based on this, technology companies can consider the findings in this study as a reference in developing features on smartwatches and developing their marketing communication strategies.

articleTitle: A Review of Equipment and Signal Processing of The Automated Auscultation for Blood Pressure Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Symposium on Material and Electrical Engineering Conference (ISMEE)
